name: reflect
description: Notices when you keep pushing back on Claude Code, works out why, and tells the agent before its next step. Each of your messages is judged by Claude Haiku 5.5; when two land as pushback within six turns, Claude Opus 5.5 reads them and the agent receives a short note.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Used for the judge and reflection calls, billed to this key. Leave empty if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is already set in your environment or you use `ant auth login`.

reflection_model.title: Reflection model
reflection_model.description: Model that writes the reflection when pushback clusters. The judge on each message is always Claude Haiku 5.5.

max_usd_per_session.title: Spend cap per session (USD)
max_usd_per_session.description: reflect stops calling the API in a session once its calls there have cost this much.
